items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1958-12-22
items.q: Kid Thomas does it over across the river.

ctx.x: been. Yeah, I have one in there, I use it with George's band. Really?
I never saw anybody do it with George's band. No. Kid Thomas does it over across the river.
I've got the slap stick in there somewhere, right? No, it's someplace I've been there.
